verdict.rationale: three.js publishes a live, HTTP-200 llms.txt at the site root and a dedicated docs llms.txt with an explicit 'Instructions for Large Language Models' section plus a 363 KB llms-full.txt, confirmed by direct probes and content excerpts. This is precisely the agent-oriented docs entry point the story asks for. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent actually consuming these files successfully, and human docs remain hash-routed rather than agent-navigable outside the llms.txt path.
